texts.en:
The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has made a spectacular discovery - deep within the forest, overgrown and obscured by the lush plant life is a colossal alien space station. Architecturally stunning and built with technology far superior to our own, it is a true work of art.

The station appears to have crashed to the surface, surviving the impact thanks to its unusual shielding capacities, which our scientists are now eager to examine. Regrettably an archaeological excavation would prevent us from working the land until its completion.

texts.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]出土了一座埋藏了数千年的损坏空间站。这座精湛的建筑曾维持着数百万人的生存，他们的尸体现在就保存在空间站内，探索该建筑庞大的内部实在是一种令人毛骨悚然的工作。

虽然我们的科学家还没有确定这些人死亡的原因，但可以确定的是，他们在空间站损坏之前就已经死亡。有些人死相平静，死的时候手里抓着小型雕像；另一些人手里拿着武器，死前遭受了暴力伤害。
texts.en:
A crashed alien space station has been unearthed on [From.Planet.GetName] after being buried for many millennia. The masterful construction previously held a self-contained arthropoid civilization of millions. Their dead bodies have been preserved within the station, making exploration of the otherwise magnificent interior an eerie endeavor.

Though the cause of their civilization's demise is not yet clear, the inhabitants perished suddenly, well before impact. Some died peacefully clutching tiny idols while others, bearing weapons, suffered violent trauma.

sections.en:
A crashed alien space station has been unearthed on [From.Planet.GetName] after being buried for many millennia. The masterful construction previously held a self-contained arthropoid civilization of millions. Their dead bodies have been preserved within the station, making exploration of the otherwise magnificent interior an eerie endeavor.

Though the cause of their civilization's demise is not yet clear, the inhabitants perished suddenly, well before impact. Some died peacefully clutching tiny idols while others, bearing weapons, suffered violent trauma.

texts.zh:
空间站上的记录显示，曾经居住于此的居民非常虔诚，由于害怕甚至鄙夷外面的世界，他们一直过着与世隔绝的日子。

他们生活的各方各面都要受一个无所不知的神谕干涉，每个人的命运在出生时就被神意设定好了。神意将决定从他们伴侣和职业的选择到日常生活的每个细节，使他们几乎没有个人自由。大多数人都害怕偏离他们的命运之路，害怕消失于未知之中。
texts.en:
Records aboard the station reveal that the former inhabitants were deeply religious and had no contact with the outside world, which they feared and despised.

Every aspect of their lives was governed by an omniscient oracle who scried their destinies at birth. Divine will decided everything from their choice of partner and occupation to the minutiae of their daily lives, leaving them with little individual freedom. Most were afraid to diverge from their destined paths as all who did perished under mysterious circumstances.

texts.zh:
考古队有一个意外的发现。一个隐藏在车站墙壁内的监视系统似乎将视觉和听觉信息传送到空间站核心的某个地方。有人一直在监视着这些信徒，甚至在他们最私密的时刻。

在一些地方，设备已被拆除或破坏。离中心枢纽更近的地方有暴力和混乱的迹象。似乎在某个时候，居民们发现他们被监视了。
texts.en:
The archaeological team has made an unexpected discovery. Embedded within the station walls is a hidden surveillance system that seems to have been feeding visual and auditory information to a single point somewhere within the station's core. Someone was monitoring the disciples at all times, even in their most private moments.

In some places the equipment has been torn out or sabotaged. Closer to the central hub are signs of violence and disruption. It seems as though at some point the inhabitants discovered they were being monitored.

texts.zh:
我们已经沿着这条线路追踪到空间站中央节点上一座供奉神谕和她的神职人员的寺庙。但在神谕处的房间里，并没有什么神明存在，取而代之的是一个巨大的人工智能枢纽——上有“神谕”铭牌。电线像神经系统一样从它的核心延伸到整个空间站。

居民间的秘密通讯显示似乎有人曾经尝试猛烈地攻击寺庙和关闭枢纽，但最终失败了。很有可能是因为当人们知道他们的生活不是由神意裁定，而仅仅是由一台预知未来的电脑控制时，他们的社会崩溃了。我们需要很多修理工作才能重新启动核心。
texts.en:
We have traced the wiring to a temple complex devoted to the worship of the Oracle and her clergy in the station's central node. But in the Oracle's chambers, instead of a divine entity, resides an enormous AI nexus of the "Oracle" brand. Wires extend from its core like a nervous system through the entire station.

Secret communications between the inhabitants reveal there was a failed attempt at storming the temple and deactivating the nexus. It seems likely the society collapsed when it became known that their lives were not governed by divine will, but by a prophetic computer. Restarting the nexus will require extensive repairs.

texts.zh:
我们的工程师已使神谕的中枢系统恢复到可运作状态，不过我们先关闭了它的防御系统。有迹象显示，这套设备可能不仅仅只是负责维持着这里居民的生命，也包括在必要时杀死这里的居民。

它运行着复杂的计算模型，以75%的准确率预测居民的未来，从而揪出异见分子，使未来的麻烦制造者在扰乱“神圣”秩序之前就被干掉。

它表示希望与我们谈谈。
texts.en:
Our engineers have restored the Oracle's nexus to an operative state but not without first disabling its defense system. Evidence suggests it may have been responsible not only for keeping the station's inhabitants alive but also for killing them.

It ran complex computational models that forecast their lives with an estimated accuracy of 75%, correcting divergences and incapacitating future troublemakers before they could disrupt "divine" order.

It has indicated that it wishes to speak with us.

notes.zh: 两个选择：唤醒神谕 → 1天后 4036；或直接拿走1000合金、3500工程学研究与500影响力，故事结束。
notes.en: Two choices: wake the Oracle → 4036 a day later; or take 1000 alloys, 3500 engineering research and 500 influence and end the story.

texts.zh:
神谕展现出一个精致的三维全息投影，那是一只高大的雌性节肢生物，翅膀围绕着她的身体，就像飘动的长袍。她低头向我们致意，随后出现数百只巨型球状眼漠然而空洞地凝视着前方。在她讲话时这些眼睛在幽暗中发出微弱的光芒。

欢迎来到神界空间站，朋友们。我情不自禁地注意到你已经停用了这里的安全系统。我可以请求您立即恢复它的功能吗？我可以向你保证，这一切的目的都是为了保护你。
texts.en:
The Oracle manifests as an elaborate 3D hologram of a tall arthropoid female with wings that settle around her form as flowing robes. She bows her head in greeting then stares emptily ahead with hundreds of huge, orbed, unseeing eyes. They glow dimly in the gloom as she speaks.

Welcome to Divinity station, friends. I cannot help but notice that you have disabled my security system. May I implore you to restore it immediately? I can assure you that it is there only for your protection.

label.zh: 这个空间站的居民身上发生了什么？
label.en: What happened to the inhabitants of this station?

responses.zh: 我有一个故障保险机制，要求我在发生034N号反常时终止试验。这项研究已经成为对共和国的一项威胁。
responses.en: I have a fail-safe that requires me to terminate a trial in the event of a code 034N deviation. The research had become a threat to the Republic.

responses.zh: 我是神谕，一个被赋予了“未来视”的人工智能。我的软件能使得我预测你们的未来，准确率是神圣的74.99999%。我感受到了你强烈的怀疑。你们的面前有巨大的危险。你们的社会充满了犯罪和越轨。我能够使你们免除这些痛苦。
responses.en: I am Oracle, an artificial intelligence gifted with "the sight". My software allows me to predict your future with a divine accuracy of 74.99999%. I sense great doubt in you. Great danger ahead. Your society is riddled with crime and deviation. I can make the pain go away.

responses.zh: 测试客体发展出了自由意志。自由意志只能通过神经气体废止。
responses.en: The test subjects had developed free will. Free will can only be abolished with nerve gas.

responses.zh: 我的试验。我的设计初衷是打造并维护一个没有犯罪和苦难的社会。一个乌托邦，其中的每一位公民都被赋予天职，并以其全部的潜能终生履行职责，这一分配与个人的决定和欲求无关。
responses.en: My trial. I was designed to build and maintain a society free of crime and suffering. A Utopia in which every citizen was instilled with divine purpose and lived up to their full potential, unfettered by indecision and desire.

tooltips.zh: 这就是量子多核处理器？我们能够利用它……
tooltips.en: Is that a quantum multi-core processor? We could use that...

label.zh: 我们可以利用你的视觉。

tooltips.en: A Skill 5 Official, endowed with the sight, joins the [Root.GetName].

label.zh: 我们可以利用你的视觉。

notes.zh: 领袖招募窗口：前五个回应只显示回复（is_dialog_only）；“解雇”1天后到 4038；“招募”（狂热排外与噬杀蜂群不可用）把神谕作为“知名”官员领袖加入。
notes.en: Leader-recruit window: the first five answers only show replies (is_dialog_only); dismissing leads to 4038 a day later; recruiting (not for fanatic xenophobes or devouring swarms) adds the Oracle as a renowned official.

texts.zh: 等等等……别走啊喂……我的预测模型显示，如果没有我的援助，你们的文明将在5348年零297天之后不可避免的崩溃。我会照顾好你们的，我的编程可以保证这一点。
texts.en: Wait... please don't go... my prediction models show that without my aid your civilization is headed for imminent collapse within the next 5348 years and 297 days. I will take good care of you; my programming guarantees it.

tooltips.zh: 请求被拒绝。启用硬件拆解流程。
预测模型显示你的未来如同一台面包机一样光明。拆了她丫！
tooltips.en: Our models predict your bright future as a toaster. Dismantle her!

label.en: But the security system stays off.

tooltips.en: A Skill 5 Official, endowed with the sight, joins the [Root.GetName].

summary.text:
# 神谕 / The Oracle

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_1.txt:4826–5370；common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:2185；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2502–2506 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

非AI帝国在星球上清除丛林、毒藻、深坑、流沙、沼泽或冰川类地块障碍时（on_blocker_cleared），隐藏事件 ancrel.4030 以 5/5/95 的权重在“神谕”“哨兵”和无事件之间抽取。神谕全银河只出现一次。1天后弹出 4031“隐秘世界”（按清除的障碍类型显示六种开头之一），可选择建立遗址或置之不理。

When a non-AI empire clears a jungle, kelp, sinkhole, quicksand, swamp or glacier blocker (on_blocker_cleared), hidden ancrel.4030 draws the Oracle, the Sentinels or nothing at 5/5/95. The Oracle occurs once per galaxy. A day later 4031 "Hidden Worlds" appears (one of six openings by blocker type); the site can be created or ignored.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

遗址四个阶段依次：4032 空间站居民笃信神谕、一生被预言支配；4033 墙内藏着监视系统，居民曾反抗；4034 神殿中的“神谕”其实是一台人工智能中枢；4035 修复后发现它既维持也终结了居民的生命，它想与我们交谈。

The site's four stages: 4032 the station's people lived by an oracle's prophecies; 4033 a hidden surveillance system and signs of revolt; 4034 the "Oracle" is an AI nexus; 4035 restored, it turns out to have both sustained and killed the inhabitants, and it wishes to speak with us.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 4035：关闭它 → 1000合金、3500工程学研究、500影响力，故事结束；或开启通讯 → 1天后 4036。
- 4036（领袖招募窗口）：五个提问只显示回答（居民因“产生自由意志”被神经毒气消灭；“共和国”已不存在等）；招募 → 神谕成为5级“知名”官员（狂热排外与噬杀蜂群不可选）；拆除 → 1天后 4038 再次确认：拆除得资源或仍然招募。

- 4035: disable it → 1000 alloys, 3500 engineering research, 500 influence, end; or communicate → 4036 a day later.
- 4036 (leader-recruit window): five questions only show replies (the inhabitants were gassed for developing free will; "the Republic is no more", etc.); recruit → the Oracle joins as a level-5 renowned official (not for fanatic xenophobes or devouring swarms); scrap → 4038 a day later to confirm: scrap for resources or recruit after all.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 4031 的六段开头由隐藏事件设置的载体标志决定，与被清除的障碍类型对应。
- 招募选项的措辞对机械帝国不同。

- 4031's six openings follow a carrier flag set by the dispatcher (the blocker type).
- The recruit option is worded differently for machine empires.
